title: Memory source settings
description: Reads text from the app’s memory through a pointer chain found with a tool like Cheat Engine.

encoding.description: How the app stores its text.

pointers.description: One pointer chain per supported build of the app.

exe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the app executable this chain was found in.

address.description: Base address in hex, relative to a module ("gta2.exe+272F40") or absolute ("4A2F40").

offsets.description: Offsets in hex: at each step, read the pointer at the address and add the offset.
